`stock_report.py` now marks an item `REORDER` when what's on hand is less than 6 days of average sales. `LEAD_TIME_DAYS = 6` sits at the top of the file for when you switch suppliers.

Running it on your current `inventory.csv` flags two items:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend has 9 on hand against about 14 needed (2.4 a day), and oat milk has 30 against 45 (7.5 a day). Items with zero on hand still show `OUT`.

An item with exactly 6 days of stock left still shows `ok`, since on paper it runs out just as the delivery lands. Because the report runs nightly and the order goes in the next day at the earliest, you may want a day of cushion: setting the number to 7 does that.
